20261119-chemistry-m3.title: Lokacin da 4 g na copper suka amsa gaba ɗaya
20261119-chemistry-m3.topic: Lokacin da 4 g na copper suka amsa gaba ɗaya
20261119-chemistry-m3.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Lokacin da 4 g na copper suka amsa gaba ɗaya don warware matsalar bincike.
20261119-chemistry-m3.material: An ƙona foda na copper a cikin crucible a cikin iska domin a samar da copper(II) oxide. Lokacin da 4 g na copper suka amsa gaba ɗaya, an samu 5 g na copper(II) oxide. Nawa ne taron oxygen da ya haɗu, kuma menene rabon taro na copper da oxygen?

20261121-chemistry-m3-1.title: A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya
20261121-chemistry-m3-1.topic: A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya
20261121-chemistry-m3-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya don warware matsalar bincike.
20261121-chemistry-m3-1.material: A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya, hydrogen da oxygen suna amsawa su samar da tururin ruwa. Menene daidaitaccen 'rabon girma' na hydrogen, oxygen da tururin ruwa da aka samu? (dokar amsawar iskar gas)
20261121-chemistry-m3-1.thinking.0: A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya
20261121-chemistry-m3-1.s.s1.prompt: A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya, hydrogen da oxygen suna amsawa su samar da tururin ruwa. Menene daidaitaccen 'rabon girma' na hydrogen, oxygen da tururin ruwa da aka samu? (dokar amsawar iskar gas)
20261121-chemistry-m3-1.s.s1.explain: A cikin lissafin $2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2\text{O}(g)$, a yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya rabon lambobin iskar gas daidai yake da rabon yawan molecule da kuma rabon girma, wato $2 : 1 : 2$.
20261121-chemistry-m3-1.s.s1.hint.1: Bisa dokar Avogadro, rabon lamba na iskar gas = rabon mole = rabon girma.

20261121-chemistry-m3-2.title: Wane haɗin ne ya bayyana daidai yadda
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.topic: Wane haɗin ne ya bayyana daidai yadda
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Wane haɗin ne ya bayyana daidai yadda don warware matsalar bincike.
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.material: Wane haɗin ne ya bayyana daidai yadda ƙarfi ke shiga da fita a cikin na'urar dumama hannu da ake girgizawa a lokacin sanyi (oxidation na ƙurar ƙarfe) da kuma jakar sanyaya da ake amfani da ita wajen magance rauni na kwatsam (amsawar ammonium nitrate da ruwa)?
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.thinking.0: Wane haɗin ne ya bayyana daidai yadda
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.s.s1.prompt: Wane haɗin ne ya bayyana daidai yadda ƙarfi ke shiga da fita a cikin na'urar dumama hannu da ake girgizawa a lokacin sanyi (oxidation na ƙurar ƙarfe) da kuma jakar sanyaya da ake amfani da ita wajen magance rauni na kwatsam (amsawar ammonium nitrate da ruwa)?
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.s.s1.explain: Oxidation na ƙarfe amsawar fitar zafi ne wanda ke sakin ƙarfin zafi zuwa kewaye ya ɗaga zafin jiki, yayin da narkewar ammonium nitrate amsawar shan zafi ne wanda ke ɗaukar ƙarfin zafi daga kewaye ya rage zafin jiki.
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Na'urar dumama tana ɗumama kewaye, don haka tana fitar da zafi (exothermic).
20261121-chemistry-m3-2.s.s1.hint.1: Jakar sanyaya tana ɗaukar zafin kewaye ta sanyaya shi, don haka tana shan zafi (endothermic).

20261118-chemistry-h1.thinking.0: Wane sakamakon gwaji ne ya fi daidai wajen
20261118-chemistry-h1.s.s1.prompt: Wane sakamakon gwaji ne ya fi daidai wajen kwatanta ikon gudanar da wutar lantarki na abu A (sodium chloride) da abu B (sukari)?
20261118-chemistry-h1.s.s1.explain: Sodium chloride mai ionic bond yana rabuwa zuwa cations da anions a ruwa, don haka maganinsa yana gudanar da wutar lantarki, yayin da sukari mai covalent bond yana narkewa a matsayin molecule ba tare da masu ɗaukar caji ba, don haka ba ya gudanarwa.
20261118-chemistry-h1.s.s1.hint.0: Abu mai ionic bond (NaCl) yana rabuwa zuwa ions masu motsi cikin 'yanci idan aka narkar da shi a ruwa.
20261118-chemistry-h1.s.s1.hint.1: Abu mai covalent molecule (sukari) yana wanzuwa a matsayin molecule ko da an narkar da shi a ruwa, ba shi da ions.
20261118-chemistry-h1.s.s1.o.o0: A yana gudanar da wutar lantarki a cikin maganin ruwa, kuma B ba ya gudanarwa a yanayin tsayayye ko a maganin ruwa

20261118-chemistry-h1.s.s1.o.o2: A ba ya gudanar da wutar lantarki a maganin ruwa, amma B yana gudanarwa a maganin ruwa

20261121-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: Menene ingantaccen ma'anar 'oxidation' da 'reduction' a kimiyyar zamani bisa canja wurin electron?

20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Mene ne ƙa'idar 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode)', inda ake haɗa gungu na zinc (Zn) ko magnesium (Mg) a gadojin ƙarfe ko jiragen ruwa na iron (Fe) don hana tsatsa?
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.explain: Idan aka haɗa iron da zinc ko magnesium waɗanda ke oxidize cikin sauƙi (suna da babban son zama ion), zinc yana rasa electrons ya lalace (oxidize) a madadin iron yana ci gaba da ba iron electrons, don haka ana hana lalacewar iron daga tushe.

20261122-chemistry-h1-1.title: Tsarin abu mai zurfi
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Tsarin abu mai zurfi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.material: [Tsarin abu mai zurfi] Wane jeri ne ya nuna daidai adadin electron pairs masu haɗawa da marasa haɗawa na methane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃) da ruwa (H₂O), waɗanda sinadarai ne na nonmetals a period na 2 masu cika ka'idar octet (electrons 8 a bawon waje)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Tsarin abu mai zurfi] Wane jeri ne ya nuna daidai adadin electron pairs masu haɗawa da marasa haɗawa na methane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃) da ruwa (H₂O), waɗanda sinadarai ne na nonmetals a period na 2 masu cika ka'idar octet (electrons 8 a bawon waje)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Methane ($\text{CH}_4$) yana da pair $4$ masu haɗawa da $0$ marasa haɗawa. Ammonia ($\text{NH}_3$) bisa yanayin nitrogen yana da $3$ masu haɗawa da $1$ mara haɗawa, kuma ruwa ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) yana da $2$ masu haɗawa da $2$ marasa haɗawa.
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Carbon (C) yana da valence electrons 4 kuma yana raba su duka da atom 4 na hydrogen.
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Nitrogen (N) yana raba 3 cikin 5 na electrons ɗinsa kuma 2 suna yin pair 1 mara haɗawa. Oxygen (O) yana raba 2 cikin 6 kuma 4 suna yin pair 2 marasa haɗawa.

20261122-chemistry-h1-2.title: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.topic: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.material: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur dioxide (SO₂) ko nitrogen oxides (NOx) da ake fitarwa daga ƙona man burbushin halittu ke amsawa da tururin ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da sulfuric acid ko nitric acid kuma su rage pH na ruwan sama ƙasa da na al'ada (kusan 5.6)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.thinking.0: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur dioxide (SO₂) ko nitrogen oxides (NOx) da ake fitarwa daga ƙona man burbushin halittu ke amsawa da tururin ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da sulfuric acid ko nitric acid kuma su rage pH na ruwan sama ƙasa da na al'ada (kusan 5.6)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.explain: Sulfur oxides da nitrogen oxides suna amsawa da ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da acid masu ƙarfi, sulfuric acid ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$) da nitric acid ($\text{HNO}_3$), don haka ruwan sama mai ƙarfin acid mai $\text{pH} < 5.6$ yana sauka yana maida ƙasa da tabkuna acidic.
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: Nonmetal oxides da ke narkewa a ruwa a sararin samaniya suna samar da maganin acidic.
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.hint.1: Yana nufin ruwan sama mai pH ƙasa da 5.6.
